component.name: PosterRowsScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 ' Content items carry NO fields, so nothing can widen or heighten a cell — except r3, ' which needs a real caption to measure the caption zone. for each id in ["r1", "r2", "r4", "r5", "r6"] m.top.findNode(id).content = makeContent(3, false) end for m.top.findNode("r3").content = makeContent(3, true)
m.settleTimer = m.top.findNode("settleTimer") m.settleTimer.observeField("fire", "onSettled") m.settleTimer.control = "start" end sub
function makeContent(count as integer, withTitle as boolean) as object root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to count - 1 item = root.createChild("ContentNode") if withTitle then item.title = "Cap" + itos(i) end for return root end function
sub onSettled() p("all", "start", "") report("R1-one-row-baseline", "r1", "height=cell+2*marginY; poster is 100 tall - what is the cell?") report("R2-no-empty-caption-bg", "r2", "showBackgroundForEmptyCaptions=false - does the extra height go away?") report("R3-one-caption-line", "r3", "caption1NumLines=1 with titles - does the cell grow by a line?") report("R4-three-rows-no-array", "r4", "3 rows, itemSpacing.y=50 -> TRAILING gap gives 3 gaps, N-1 gives 2") report("R5-short-array", "r5", "3 rows, rowSpacings=[10], itemSpacing.y=50 -> FALLBACK gives 10+50+50, REPEAT gives 10+10+10") report("R6-row-heights", "r6", "rowHeights=[200,50,100] - honored, or ignored like columnWidths?") p("all", "done", "") m.top.probeExit = true end sub
sub report(caseId as string, nodeId as string, note as string) node = m.top.findNode(nodeId) p("R-postergrid", caseId, "rect=" + r(node.boundingRect()) + " | " + note) end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function r(rect as object) as string if rect = invalid then return "<invalid>" out = "{x=" + n(rect.x) out = out + " y=" + n(rect.y) out = out + " w=" + n(rect.width) out = out + " h=" + n(rect.height) return out + "}" end function
function n(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "?" if v >= 0 then return itos(int(v + 0.5)) return itos(-int(-v + 0.5)) end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
sub p(phase as string, caseId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + caseId + "|" + detail end sub
